cases.sentence: Вот слово, которое было к Иеремии от Господа во время правления ___ Иоакима, сына Иосии :
cases.explain: «иудейского царя» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

cases.sentence: — Пойди к членам рода рехавитов, пригласи их прийти в одну из ___ дома Господня и предложи выпить вина.
cases.explain: «боковых комнат» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “Go to the house of the Rechabites, and speak to them, and bring them into Yahweh’s house, into one of the rooms, and give them wine to drink.”

cases.sentence: Я поставил перед членами рода рехавитов чаши, ___, и несколько кубков и сказал им:
cases.explain: «полные вина» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, “Drink wine!”

cases.sentence: Они говорили: “Обратитесь каждый от своего ___ и оставьте свои злые деяния; не следуйте за чужими богами, чтобы служить им.
cases.explain: «злого пути» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I have sent also to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, ‘Every one of you must return now from his evil way, amend your doings, and don’t go after other gods to serve them, then you will dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers:’ but you have not inclined your ear, nor listened to me.

cases.sentence: Они говорили: “Обратитесь каждый от своего злого пути и оставьте свои злые деяния; не следуйте за ___, чтобы служить им.
cases.explain: «чужими богами» — after the preposition «за», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: I have sent also to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, ‘Every one of you must return now from his evil way, amend your doings, and don’t go after other gods to serve them, then you will dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers:’ but you have not inclined your ear, nor listened to me.
